records.text: An unnamed priest flew with Erika Kirk to Utah, was with her when she learned Charlie Kirk had died, prayed over him at the hospital, and delivered the homily at the private funeral.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep Wjul6YV6izo)

appearances.snippet: he was actually the priest that flew with Erika to utah he was with her when they called her that he did not make it he prayed over him she actually asked him to pray the rosary there at the hospital ... He said the homily at the private funeral the Friday before the memorial.

verification.notes: The transcript makes this an anonymous email account about an unnamed priest. Live searches found public confirmation that Erika Kirk reached a Utah hospital and that a private funeral occurred, but no reliable source identifying this priest or confirming his flight, hospital prayer, rosary, and homily roles.

records.text: Charlie Kirk went to Mass at that church, where the priest would open the building so he could pray and reflect without interruption; the priest stayed with Erika Kirk from Arizona through the Utah hospital visit.
records.speaker: Erika Kirk

appearances.snippet: She mentioned that Charlie went to Mass with her there and that Father Don would open the church up for him. There are often when Charlie just wanted to pray and reflect without being disrupted and that he was with her the entire time from Arizona to Utah in the hospital,

verification.notes: This is attributed to a private church conversation reported through an anonymous email. Current searches found no reliable public source confirming that Father Don opened the church for Charlie Kirk or accompanied Erika Kirk continuously from Arizona through the Utah hospital visit.

conveyance.original_source: Email recounting a private church conversation
